function.name: ambient_publish
function.description: Publish the user's current state to subscribed agents. Pass only the fields that changed. Never include raw personal data (titles, locations).

function.name: ambient_request
function.description: Ask another Ambient-A2A agent to control a device (device.control). The target agent decides; the reply says accepted or rejected with reason_code.

target.description: Agent id: desktop, smartphone, orchestrator, room1, room2

device.description: HA entity id, e.g. input_boolean.living_tv_muted. Omit for ENERGY_SAVING.

function.name: ambient_status
function.description: Show this agent's devices, received context and subscriptions.

function.name: gateway
function.description: Update OpenClaw with update.run on an explicit owner request or an operator-scheduled automation. Restart and completion notice are automatic. Never via shell.

note.description: Short human note for the post-update restart notice.

function.name: presence
function.description: Read live people, connected devices, and observed activity on this Gateway. list (default): who is online, one entry per person. person: inspect me, a profile ID, or an unambiguous name. device: inspect a deviceId returned by presence. Include devices for recent activity and its source, network for IP addresses, or location for approximate IP geography (not GPS). Online means connected, not necessarily active. Unknown activity is not inactivity. Shared or unidentified machines remain separate from people; list with devices includes them. This is a current snapshot, not activity history or permission to control a device.

action.description: List connected people (default), inspect a person, or inspect a connected device.

person.description: For person: me, a returned person/profile ID, or an exact unambiguous display name.

deviceId.description: For device: the exact presence device ID returned by this tool.

include.description: Optional device details. Network includes IP; location includes approximate IP location without requesting GPS. Each option includes devices.

limit.description: Maximum people returned (default 50, maximum 100); truncation is reported.

function.name: session_status
function.description: Show visible-session model/usage/time/cost/tasks. `sessionKey="current"` for current; UI labels are not keys. `model` overrides; `model=default` resets. Use for active model/session questions.

user.description: The person's requester_profile.id, required when several people have steered this turn.
